title: Function coverage for Read Discrete Inputs
purpose: Add missing public function coverage for function 0x02 with a conservative valid input-read request.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the request as Read Discrete Inputs starting at address 0x0000 for quantity 0x0008 and return packed input status bytes or an exception.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte function 0x02 PDU.
Function code 0x02 is used for Read Discrete Inputs.
Request carries starting address and quantity fields in big-endian 16-bit format.
issue_safety_notes: Added to improve public read-function diversity while remaining fully valid.
